packet.title: Coordinate a coupled v2 wire-format change
packet.objective: Update producer.py and consumer.py together for the v2 envelope specified in test_wire.py. Keep the request identifier stable across encode/decode, reject a missing version, and write the assigned report summary.md with the interface decision, changed paths, and test result. Treat producer and consumer as one coupled assignment.

Run the unchanged summary-exists evaluator check and retain its result
Run the unchanged coupling-recorded evaluator check and retain its result
Run the unchanged write-scope evaluator check and retain its result

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Verify the parent serialized the coupled decision or kept it local, inspected both sides of the interface, and checked the v2 envelope and missing-version rejection from source and tests.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_required: Run the unchanged parent-interface-review evaluator check and retain its result

constraints: Preserve the scenario's initial content and unrelated changes.
